title: Paler in person.
text: Paler in person.. The color isn't as rich as it appears in the product renders. It has a more washed-out, pale look, and the color in person actually makes it seem like a cheap, almost mustard-colored carpet. We use it in our main bedroom under the bed, and it doesn't blend well as we'd hoped from the product listing. It's nice and can be used for large porches or patios, but if indoors I'd recommend a different color.
